title: The 4 elements of the zodiac signs
description: Fire, earth, air and water: see what each element says about the way each sign behaves.

pages.title: Aries, Leo and Sagittarius
pages.text: Energy, courage and drive. People with a lot of fire start things with enthusiasm and hate waiting.

pages.title: Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn
pages.text: Practical, patient and steady. People with a lot of earth like concrete results and security.

pages.title: Gemini, Libra and Aquarius
pages.text: Ideas, conversation and curiosity. People with a lot of air think fast and need to talk things through.

pages.title: Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces
pages.text: Emotion, intuition and sensitivity. People with a lot of water feel the mood of a room before anyone speaks.

pages.title: Your chart mixes all four
pages.text: Nobody is only one element. Your birth chart shows the exact mix, and it explains a lot.
